questions.stem: Which of the following shapes is a cylinder?

choices.B: A rectangular prism with circular ends
choices.C: A sphere with a flat base
choices.D: A cone with a wide base

questions.solution: A cylinder has two parallel, congruent circular bases and a curved surface connecting them. The correct answer is B: A rectangular prism with circular ends because it matches this description.
questions.explanation: A cube does not have circular bases (A), a sphere does not have a flat base or straight sides (C), and a cone has only one circular base and a slanted side (D).
questions.common_mistake_notes: Common mistake is confusing a cylinder with a rectangular prism, which may have circular ends but is not a cylindrical surface.

questions.stem: Identify the cylindrical object in this group of items:
questions.solution: A rolled-up poster has a circular cross-section and a continuous curved surface, which are the defining characteristics of a cylinder. The correct answer is B.
questions.explanation: A stack of books, a triangular prism, and a rectangular box do not have cylindrical shapes; they have flat surfaces or non-ircular cross-sections.
questions.common_mistake_notes: Common mistake is selecting A, as books may be arranged in a way that resembles a cylinder, but their individual flat surfaces disqualify them.

questions.stem: Which of the following equations represents the volume of a right circular cylinder?
questions.solution: The formula for the volume of a right circular cylinder is V = πr²h, where r is the radius and h is the height. The correct answer is A.
questions.explanation: B represents the volume of a cone, C represents the volume of a sphere, and D is not a valid formula for any common 3D shape.
questions.common_mistake_notes: Common mistake is confusing the cylinder's volume formula with that of a cone or sphere.

questions.stem: What part of a can is cylindrical?

choices.C: The entire shape, including the lid and body
choices.D: The curved surface connecting the top and bottom

questions.solution: The curved surface connecting the top and bottom of a can is cylindrical. The correct answer is D.
questions.explanation: The label on the side is flat, the top and bottom lids are circular but not curved, and the entire shape includes non-cylindrical parts like the seam and lid edges.
questions.common_mistake_notes: Common mistake is selecting C, as people may overlook that the lids are separate from the cylindrical body.

questions.stem: In a factory, which machine part is likely to be cylindrical?
questions.solution: A round gear with teeth has a cylindrical shape, as it is circular and has a continuous curved surface. The correct answer is C.
questions.explanation: A square nut, flat washer, and hexagonal bolt are all shapes with flat surfaces or non-circular cross-sections.
questions.common_mistake_notes: Common mistake is selecting A or D, as people may focus on the circular shape but forget that a cylinder also has a continuous curved surface.

questions.stem: Identify the cylindrical object in this room:

choices.D: The lampshade hanging from the ceiling

questions.solution: A table leg typically has a cylindrical shape, with a circular cross-section and a continuous curved surface. The correct answer is B.
questions.explanation: A pillow, vase, and lampshade may have circular elements but do not have the continuous curved surface of a cylinder; they are either flat or have other non-cylindrical features like a base or top.
questions.common_mistake_notes: Common mistake is selecting A or D, as people may focus on the circular shape but forget that a cylinder also has a continuous curved surface.

questions.stem: What part of a pencil is cylindrical?

choices.B: The wooden body with the graphite core
choices.C: The metal ferrule holding the eraser and graphite
choices.D: The label wrapping around the pencil

questions.solution: The wooden body with the graphite core of a pencil is cylindrical, having a circular cross-section and a continuous curved surface. The correct answer is B.
questions.explanation: The eraser, metal ferrule, and label all have non-cylindrical features like flat surfaces or edges.
questions.common_mistake_notes: Common mistake is selecting A or D, as people may focus on the circular shape but forget that a cylinder also has a continuous curved surface.
